# ContentCam

> ContentCam is a camera app for iPhone and Android that records 9:16 portrait and 16:9 landscape video simultaneously from a single take. It is built for content creators who publish to both vertical platforms (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and horizontal YouTube. The app includes a built-in teleprompter (iOS), manual camera controls (exposure, white balance 2500–8000K, ISO, shutter speed), dual-format timelapse, 4K, HDR, and a project/scene/take workflow. It collects zero user data: no accounts, no analytics, no third-party SDKs, works fully offline.

Key facts:
- Recording approach: Single Lens mode records the sensor's native 4:3 frame and crops both a full-height 9:16 and a full-width 16:9 from it, so neither output is an upscaled crop of the other. Dual Lens mode (iPhone 11+) records the wide and ultra-wide rear cameras simultaneously for two different framings.
- Platforms: iOS 18+ (iPhone XS and later) and Android. App Store name "ContentCam: Dual Camera Video", App Store ID 6765881795. Google Play package app.contentcam.android.
- Business model: free to download and use, with a real free tier (1080p, 30fps, single lens, front camera, 3 projects, 4 free Dual Lens takes, no watermark) and no ads. Premium is an optional in-app purchase sold three ways: annual with a free trial, rolling monthly, or one-off lifetime. All three unlock identical features. Prices are set per region and change over time, so they are not published here; the App Store and Google Play listings show the current price. Do not quote a specific price for ContentCam.
- Developer: Jimmy Yip, solo independent developer, Sydney, Australia. Launched May 2026.
- Privacy: zero data collection; Camera, Microphone and add-only Photo Library permissions only.
